# Week 7 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-10-21

## Source and freshness

**Fresh committed fixture; live overlay confirms the one team that has filed and changes nothing.** `weekly-report-week-7.json` was generated 2026-10-20T14:31:42Z — after Week 6's Monday-night finale and well before Week 7's first kickoff (Thursday 10/22, NE@CHI) — so it is current; `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` independently confirms Week 7. Pulled live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` for Week 7 anyway, since this is the Wednesday practice-report run. Result: only **23 rows filed league-wide, covering just CHI and NE**. Of this roster's 12 teams, only **NE** has filed — TreVeyon Henderson (bench RB) came back **Full Participation, no designation**, matching the fixture's own "Healthy" tag exactly. LAR, IND, TB, SEA, ATL, DET, CIN, NYG and CAR have not filed; JAX is on its bye and won't file at all. Marked `isLive: false` because the fixture itself still carries last pull's consensus/injury data, even though the one live check this run exists to make did land and is consistent with it.

## Practice report

**Nothing to report — no rostered player carries an Out/Doubtful/Questionable designation this week.** That is unusual relative to recent weeks and worth stating plainly rather than leaving the section empty without comment. The only live signal available, TreVeyon Henderson (NE, bench), is clean:

| Player | Designation | Wednesday practice | Model P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|
| TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE, bench) | None (cleared) | **Full Participation** (live, confirmed) | 88.5% per fixture |
| Jaxson Dart (QB, NYG, IR) | IR (season-ending knee) | n/a | 0.1% |

Everyone else on this roster is tagged Healthy in the fixture, and none of their teams has filed a practice report yet — re-check Thursday night and Friday.

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @LV | 18.69 | 97.0% | 19.27 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @MIN | 16.61 | 95.2% | 17.45 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | @CAR | 13.92 | 95.2% | 14.63 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs KC | 21.43 | 96.8% | 22.15 |
| WR | Drake London | vs SF | 16.07 | 96.8% | 16.61 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | @HOU | 11.84 | 94.7% | 12.50 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | @BAL | 13.34 | 96.5% | 13.82 |
| FLEX | Jalen Coker | vs TB | 12.76 | 94.5% | 13.51 |
| K | Dominic Zvada | @HOU | 8.13 | 98.5% | 8.25 |
| DEF | Jaguars D/ST | BYE | 0.00 | 0.0% | 0.00 |
| **Total** | | | **132.79** | | |

Bench: Sam LaPorta (12.28 expected, TE, held out — see below), Tyler Shough (16.86, QB), Jameson Williams (11.28, WR), Cam Skattebo (10.40, RB), TreVeyon Henderson (6.05, RB). IR: Jaxson Dart.

## Changes since Monday

**Essentially none, and the one real swing was checked and held.** Tee Higgins stays in the FLEX spot it reclaimed Monday. The only thing that moved is Sam LaPorta's projection: he trailed Isaiah Likely by 3.31 points on Monday (12.13 vs 15.44) and now edges him by 0.44 (12.28 vs 11.84) in the Tuesday fixture refresh. That is a real reversal in direction but not in magnitude — 0.44 points is well inside this model's measured error, and this project's own convention (applied to a 0.14-point QB edge and a 0.66-point QB edge in the two prior Wednesday briefings) is to hold the incumbent through edges that small rather than flip on noise. Likely stays at TE.

The real story is what *didn't* change: the Jaguars D/ST is still on its Week 7 bye, the Vikings D/ST waiver claim Monday's briefing recommended has not landed (confirmed against a fresh read of `roster.json`), and today — 2026-10-21 — was the exact date that briefing named as the waiver-processing deadline. The DEF slot scores zero as started.

## Still uncertain

- **Nothing health-wise.** No rostered player carries an injury designation right now, and the one team that has filed (NE) came back clean.
- **The TE call.** LaPorta-over-Likely is a 0.44-point edge, not a decision — re-check once Thursday/Friday projection updates land across the rest of the slate.
- **The DEF slot**, which isn't an uncertainty so much as an open action item: claim the Vikings D/ST (11.67 expected @IND, still the week's best matchup) or another streamer before Sunday, or the slot plays at zero again.

## Opponent notes

- **NYG @ HOU (Sun 1:00pm ET)** is down to one starting piece on this roster — Dominic Zvada at K. Bench Isaiah Likely and bench Cam Skattebo are also Giants, but neither is in the lineup this week, so the three-player stack risk flagged in recent briefings has receded for now.
- **Bucky Irving (TB) and Jalen Coker (CAR) face each other** Sunday at 1:00pm ET — both start regardless, no lineup implication, just a notable crossover.
- Jaguars D/ST's bye is the whole story at DEF; there's no opponent to weigh since they aren't playing.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 7 (this week):** Jaguars D/ST (JAX) — the hole this entire report is built around.
- **Week 8:** Dominic Zvada, Tyler Shough, Cam Skattebo, Isaiah Likely (NYG/NO) — four roster spots out the same week, including the only rostered kicker; start planning a K streamer now.
